definitions.explanation: Synthetic material used for clear plastic sheets, paints, and fibers in clothing. From English "acryl(ic)."

examples.japanese: このセーターはアクリル{製|せい}だ。
examples.english: This sweater is made of acrylic.

examples.japanese: アクリル{板|いた}で{仕切|しき}りを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a partition out of acrylic sheets.

examples.japanese: アクリル{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}は{乾|かわ}くのが{速|はや}いので{初心者|しょしんしゃ}にも{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: Acrylic paints dry quickly, so they are easy to use even for beginners.

notes:
Loanword covering both the transparent rigid plastic (often called plexiglass in English) and synthetic fiber used in clothing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アクリル{板|いた}: acrylic sheet, plexiglass panel
- アクリル{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}: acrylic paints
- アクリル{樹脂|じゅし}: acrylic resin
- アクリル{毛|げ}{糸|いと}: acrylic yarn
- アクリル{繊維|せんい}: acrylic fiber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プラスチック: plastic — generic term; アクリル is one specific type
- ポリエステル: polyester — different synthetic fiber, common in clothing alongside アクリル
